arStrings.szText: "Ouna was right. No one deserves eternity on the Tree."
If I can stop anyone else from taking the Tree’s oath, I will die a happy witch. If only it were not too late for so many...returning their heads will not be easy.
Player said what she was thinking. Lets anger slip. Gets control of herself.
And yet this is our task. Follow the whispers, cleanse the rot...and restore every last head to the Tree. We cannot abandon it as Caidin has.
